job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications for internal products and client projects. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Agentic AI, Python, Azure, LangGraph, and modern AI frameworks, along with a strong software engineering background.Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI applications and multi-agent systems.
Build AI POCs, production applications, APIs, and backend services.
Develop AI workflows using LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, and Claude Code.
Work with SQL, PostgreSQL, vector databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Write clean, scalable, and well-tested code with proper documentation.
Collaborate with distributed teams and participate in code reviews.
Continuously learn and implement new AI technologies and best practices.

Required Skills

4+ years of software engineering experience with Python.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI and production AI applications.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure AI Foundry.
Experience with LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Claude Code.
Knowledge of FastAPI, Docker, GitHub, SQL, PostgreSQL, and vector databases.
Experience working with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, and Gemini.
Good understanding of testing, code quality, and software engineering best practices.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Good to Have

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Snowflake or Databricks
LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex
Redis, Celery, Apache Airflow, Kafka
Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps
Playwright and AI evaluation frameworks
